verdict.rationale: ROS 2's official docs include a tutorial for launching a simulation with Gazebo, and a long-time user says ROS gives you sim 'for free' if you follow its conventions. However, the physics engine and sensor modelling come from the separate Gazebo simulator, and the pack never describes them. missing for 10: documented realistic physics simulation, documented sensor models (lidar/camera/IMU), detail on environment/world modelling, hands-on corroboration of sim fidelity before hardware.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can simulate my robot and its environment with realistic physics and sensor models before touching hardware
